mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) can potentiate dexamethasone's immunosuppressive and hyperglycemic effects while dexamethasone may increase MAOI levels through CYP450 inhibition, creating additive CNS and metabolic complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective dexamethasone dose, monitor blood glucose closely, watch for hypertensive episodes and CNS effects, and consider alternative antidepressants.
